title: Orange et moi Burkina
meta_description: The free account management application for Orange Burkina customers
full_description: Orange et moi is a free application for Orange Burkina customers that allows you to:- Consult your account in real time: minutes, sms, internet ...- Reload your account or that of a friend with Orange Money or a recharge card, or by transferring credit- Buy internet packages- Discover the latest offers and promotions- Access the Orange universes: Place, Fiber, online store- Locate your Orange stores- Find the answers to all your questions, customer service numbers in the support sectionFrom now on, you will no longer have to remember the access codes to the various services!-------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------Conditions:- Use: the Orange et moi application is accessible to Orange Burkina customers under Orange mobile coverage or with WIFI- Download: possible in Wifi and under Orange mobile network coverage (the download costs are included or deducted according to your offer).- Costs: navigation in the application is free on the Orange Burkina network (excluding roaming and locating Orange branches and shops on a map).- You like the Orange and Me app? Don't hesitate to write a review on the Store!-------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------Questions or comments?
